raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
10/2021 – present Pune
Senior Bizops (Role Business Analyst), Mastercard
Conducted sprint retrospective and followed up on action items for continuous improvement •Creating data models basis various critical business insights needed for various technical solution & business upgradation. The As-Is state was created, and the transformation scope, as well as the To-Be state, were specified. Wireframes were created using Balsamiq •Conduct gap/scope/impact analyses of business processes with tools such as use case diagrams (UML), BPMN (process modelling), and flowcharts •End-user UAT sessions and feature demonstrations were held.
Participating in a variety of AGILE events (Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Sprint Retro, Grooming Session).
Recognize and prioritise the product backlog, and work closely with the solution team to develop the best solutions possible within the constraints and expectations. Worked on Mastercard scheme and regulatory requirements, performing regulatory impact/gap analysis, translating compliance requirements into business/functional requirements, and supporting country-specific implementation, controls, testing, and business validation. Supported regulatory risk and control assessments, mapping regulatory requirements to business processes and controls, identifying compliance gaps, defining remediation actions, and maintaining risk/control traceability and compliance evidence through implementation and UAT. Conducted risk and impact assessments for business/process changes, identifying potential operational, compliance, and delivery risks and defining appropriate mitigation actions.

Dispute Lifecycle Managements Cardholder disputes usually begin when cardholders or issuers discover possible fraudulent charges or errors on accounts. Issuers and acquirers then attempt to resolve the fraudulent charges or errors by using Mastercom to navigate the dispute resolution cycle.
Summit Trade Management It provides platform to support multiple trade management and trade capturing activity through application like TPM (Trade Processing Management), SUMMIT. Summit is the main trade capture system for dual-booked settlement “marker” trade, for Rates and credit business. TPM it helps to provide interface between trade capturing venues. Summit for derivative products. Summit is a straight through trade processing solution from Finastra that allows user to business, minimizes the operation risks, reduces transactions processing cost and obtains intra-day management risk management information at the desk and enterprise level.
